newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Crown offers seven-for-10 rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Crown offers seven-for-10 rights issue.

text.p: Holding firm Crown Equities Inc said on Monday it will offer a seven-for-10 rights issue from January 13 to 24 at a price of 1.60 pesos per share.
The company said in a statement the record date for the stock rights offering is January 10, 1997.
The 1.12 billion pesos in proceeds from the rights offering will be used to pay off short-term loans and finance the company's projects for the next two years.
Crown Equities was formerly oil exploration firm Southeast Pacific Rim Resources & Development Corp. The company now has interests in real estate and banking.
